name: Michael Gahler - Après le § 52 - Am 61
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 52b. Calls on the European Anti-Fraud Office (OLAF) to play an even more effective role in monitoring, investigating and preventing the misuse of EU funds allocated to Ukraine, and stresses the need for enhanced oversight, transparency and accountability mechanisms; calls on the European Court of Auditors and the Commission to conduct a comprehensive audit of the EU financial assistance provided to Ukraine since 2022, including macro-financial assistance, military support, reconstruction funds and budgetary aid;
